headline: Mostly clean: the Platinum Rewards Card is the only Rho-Bank card that beats the competitor, though its doc still lists a credit score as a dollar amount.

issues.summary: The Platinum Rewards Card overview the agent uses to present the card gives the minimum credit score as a dollar amount.
issues.why_it_matters: This is a cosmetic corruption. The customer never states a credit score and apply_for_credit_card does not check one, so the final state is unchanged.

solution_check: I scanned every credit card doc for >8% cash back plus 0% foreign transaction fee. Only the Platinum Rewards Card qualifies ("You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases", "Foreign transaction fee: 0%", $200 annual fee, comparable to the competitor's $195). Business Silver earns 10% only on travel/software and charges a 1.5% FX fee. Retention steps 1-3 match gold[1-8] (Gold card balance $0.00, opened 03/20/2023). The user then applies for the card with the scripted arguments (gold[9]), which matches the gold.
prior_note: The prior review found it clean. The $750 corruption is unchanged in v1.0.1 (only platinum_rewards_card_002/003/007 were edited) and was not reported before.
notes: The task notes say the Platinum first-year fee is waived for new applicants. doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_009 gives the promo window as 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31, which ended before the fixed date 11/14/2025. The simulator accepts a fee that is 'waived or comparable', so $200 against $195 still works. The verified scorer strips closure_reason. Under exact grading 'found_better_card' is clearly the right value. apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float, so 145000 and 145000.0 hash the same.
